texts.en:
We arrived on a thriving planet. From its dense forests to the verdant plains, the landscape was at once diverse and immaculately maintained - a vibrant and planet-wide garden.

An unidentified plantoid species has erected extensive fortifications around the semi-organic cities. Scans of the local star system have revealed a blockade of heavily equipped warships. There is no active conflict, but it is clear that one is brewing.

texts.zh:
在行星表面，我们遇到了一种巨大的生物，它的身体由复杂的根系网络组成。$astral_rift.3005.desc.know_baol.1$我们假设这条裂缝是通往平行宇宙的大门，在那里，巴奥正在疯狂地保卫他们的殖民地。$astral_rift.3005.desc.know_baol.2$

“你好，种子同胞。解释一下你是如何绕过封锁的，以及你来这里的目的。”
texts.en:
On the planet's surface, we encountered a massive creature whose body was formed by an intricate network of roots. $astral_rift.3005.desc.know_baol.1$ We hypothesize that the rift was a doorway into a parallel universe where the Baol are furiously defending their colonies. $astral_rift.3005.desc.know_baol.2$

"Hail, seed kin. Explain how you bypassed the blockade, and for what purpose you have come."

label.zh: 告诉他们我们对巴奥的全部了解。
label.en: Disclose what we know about the Baol.

texts.zh:
我们解释说，我们知道他们的物种：我们宇宙中的巴奥是和平主义者，蜂巢思维。他们是技艺无与伦比的园丁，却遭到了一个名叫古茹努尔的军国主义种族的攻击并最终被消灭。

从目前的情况来看，这个殖民地正面临着被燃烧殆尽的危险。

巴奥感到震惊。他们解释说，古茹努尔人最近才出现，在这个殖民地周围建立了军事封锁。我们报告的每一个细节都与他们迄今为止与古茹努尔的经历相符。

他们已正式请求我们协助击退外星人的威胁，以免为时已晚。
texts.en:
We explained that their species was known to us: the Baol in our universe were a pacifistic, hive mind. Gardeners of unmatched skill, they were attacked and finally exterminated by a militaristic race called the Grunur.

The way things stand, this colony is in danger of being burned to the ground.

The Baol were alarmed. They explained that the Grunur had appeared only recently, establishing a military blockade around this colony. Every detail of our report matched their own experience with the Grunur thus far.

They have made a formal request for our assistance in repelling the alien threat before it is too late.

texts.zh:
我们解释说，我们知道他们的物种：我们宇宙中的巴奥是和平主义者，蜂巢思维。他们是技艺无与伦比的园丁，却遭到了一个名叫古茹努尔的军国主义帝国的攻击并最终被消灭。

所有巴奥星球行星和殖民地都被摧毁了。最终，只剩下一个巴奥个体，在一个废弃的研究站内被困了数千年。

巴奥感到震惊。他们解释说，古茹努尔人最近才出现，在这个殖民地周围建立了军事封锁。我们报告的每一个细节都与他们迄今为止与古茹努尔的经历相符。

他们已正式请求我们协助击退外星人的威胁，以免为时已晚。
texts.en:
We explained that their species was known to us: the Baol in our universe were a pacifistic, hive mind. Gardeners of unmatched skill, they were attacked and finally exterminated by a militaristic empire, the Grunur.

Every Baol planet and colony was destroyed. In the end, only a single Baol node remained, trapped for millenia inside an abandoned research station.

The Baol were alarmed. They explained that the Grunur had appeared only recently, establishing a military blockade around this colony. Every detail of our report matched their own experience with the Grunur thus far.

They have made a formal request for our assistance in repelling the alien threat before it is too late.

label.zh: 我们将尽我们所能提供帮助。
label.en: We will help however we can.
It is not our place to interfere.

texts.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔会把这个殖民地夷为平地。而且没有通过外交途径解决问题的机会。
texts.en: We know that the Grunur will burn this colony to the ground. There is no chance of a diplomatic resolution.

texts.zh: 我们知道古茹努尔在摧毁巴奥之前是不会停手的。而且没有通过外交途径解决问题的机会。
texts.en: We know that the Grunur will stop at nothing to destroy the Baol. There is no chance of a diplomatic resolution.

texts.zh: 我们已经与巴奥进行讨论确定提供援助的实用方法。
texts.en: We've engaged in discussions with the Baol to determine a practical way to lend aid.

texts.zh: 巴奥可以尝试自卫，但他们军事能力有限。他们可以从机械或基因增强中受益，以提高陆军的速度、力量和对燃烧武器的抵抗力。
texts.en: The Baol can attempt to defend themselves, but have limited military capabilities. They would benefit from mechanical or genetic enhancement to improve their armies' speed, strength and resistance to incendiary weapons.

texts.zh: 我们可以用临时隐形装置遮蔽他们的母星，从而帮助巴奥躲避古茹努尔。这个殖民地仍然会消失，但至少他们的文明所在地将会幸存。
texts.en: We may help the Baol evade the Grunur by obscuring their homeworld with a temporary cloaking device. This colony would still be lost, but at least the seat of their civilization will survive.

texts.zh: 我们可以尝试用星界丝缕来增强巴奥的先进有机技术。应该可以在这个殖民地周围建立一个强大的护盾。当然，这将使他们无法离开这颗行星，但至少他们也可以免受入侵者的侵害。
texts.en: We could attempt to enhance the Baol's advanced organic technology with astral thread. It should be possible to establish a powerful shield around this colony. Of course, this will prevent them from leaving the planet, but at least they would be safe from the invaders.

texts.zh: 作为最后的手段，我们可以将巴奥幼苗带回裂隙，无论这个维度发生什么，这个物种都将能够继续生存。
texts.en: As a last resort, we could carry Baol seedlings back through the Rift, allowing the species to live on no matter what happens in this dimension.

label.zh: 部署实验性行星隐形技术。

texts.zh:
我们利用基因剪裁技术的知识来强化巴奥物种，让他们准备好迎接即将到来的防御战。由于几乎没有其他选择，他们不情愿地接受了这些生物学上的变化。和平的巴奥帝国以农业和生态系统管理为基础，现在拥有一支由具有强大体力的高复原力子个体组成的常备民兵。

现在，巴奥已经为地面战做好了更多准备，出于感激之情，他们为我们提供了一个防御个体。这种专门的、半自主的生物现在将为我们服务。
texts.en:
We used our knowledge of gene tailoring technology to fortify the Baol species in their upcoming defensive campaign. With few options left, they reluctantly accepted these changes to their biology. The pacifistic Baol empire, built on agriculture and ecosystem management, is now populated by a standing militia of highly resilient drones with tremendous physical strength.

Now more prepared for land warfare, the Baol have offered us a defensive node out of gratitude. This specialized, semi-autonomous creature will now serve us.

texts.zh:
植物类种族个体的移动速度缓慢，但如果它行动迟缓是因为他们缺乏智慧，那可就大错特错。这种个体专门用于保卫集体，代表了几代精心适应的顶峰。它们冷酷而礼貌地向我们打招呼，一心想要对我们给予它们蜂巢的恩惠做出回报。

作为巴奥的一部分，我们没有名字。你可以称呼我们为橡树茎。
texts.en:
The plantoid node moves with slow deliberation, but it would be a mistake to take its lumbering for lack of intelligence. Specialized to defend the collective, this organism represents the pinnacle of generations of careful adaptation. They greet us grimly, but politely, intent on repaying the favor we bestowed upon their hive.

As part of the Baol, we had no name. You may call us Oakenstalk.

label.zh: 你是巴奥的防御专家吗？
label.en: You were a defensive specialist for the Baol?

responses.zh: 这个任务的任务是为我们的殖民地做好防御战争的准备。这涉及在围困期间管理有限的资源，以及军事防御工事的设计和维护。尽管已被封锁，这一地区仍保持稳定的人口水平。这项工作被认为是有用的。
responses.en: This one was tasked with preparing our colony for a defensive war. This involved managing limited resources while under siege, as well as the design and upkeep of military fortifications. This one maintained steady population levels despite the blockade. This one's work was deemed useful.

label.en: How do you feel about joining us?

responses.zh: 这个体为巴奥做了一切能做的事。在这个职位上，没有进一步的成长空间；当一个生命系统无法生长时，它就开始凋亡。在这个维度上还有进一步的服务机遇。还有复兴的希望。
responses.en: This one did all it could for the Baol. In that role, there was no further room for growth; when a living system fails to grow, it begins to die. In this dimension there is further opportunity for service. There is hope of renewal.

label.en: How does it feel to be separated from the collective?

responses.zh: 感到了受限。令人沮丧……同时也令人兴奋。这种感觉与该个体此前经历过的任何情况都不一样。然而，越早将该个体融入[Explorer.GetName]的工作中就越好。为一个更大的实体服务是更令人愉快的事情。
responses.en: Limited. Frustrating... Exhilarating. The sensation is unlike anything this one has ever experienced. However, the sooner this one is integrated into the workings of [Explorer.GetName] the better. It is much more agreeable to work in service of a greater entity.

label.zh: 你选择一个什么样的名字呢？
label.en: How did you choose your name?

responses.zh: 你们的一位来自星界裂隙的研究人员为这个个体提供了一个人工智能文本生成程序。根据此个体的特质进行查询，返回的结果为：橡树茎。感觉……挺合适。
responses.en: One of your researchers that came through the Astral Rift provided this one with an artificially intelligent text generation program. A query was made based on this one's qualities, and it returned: Oakenstalk. It feels... suitable.

label.zh: 基因强化：可招募橡树茎

note.zh: 裂隙探索结束，获得大量星界丝缕；巴奥指挥官“橡树茎”可以招募或遣散。
note.en: The rift exploration ends with a large astral thread reward; the Baol commander Oakenstalk can be enlisted or dismissed.

texts.zh:
在与巴奥分享隐形领域的秘密后，他们就能生产出有机隐形卫星阵列。这些实验性分枝本质短寿，并且需要少量的星界丝缕来维持，但它们应该持续足够撑到将巴奥的母星隐藏在古茹努尔的视野之外。不幸的是，这个殖民地已经为古茹努尔人所知，并且很可能是注定要灭亡的。

一旦隐形，巴奥将不得不暂时牺牲其星际旅行的雄心壮志，因为只要有飞船从母星出发的飞船都有可能会暴露其位置。当然，这种不便还是比毁灭要好得多的。
texts.en:
After sharing the secrets of the cloaking field with the Baol, they were able to produce an array of organic cloaking satellites. These experimental offshoots are temporary in nature, and require a small amount of astral thread to maintain, but they should last long enough to hide the Baol homeworld from the Grunur. Unfortunately, this colony is already known to the Grunur, and is likely doomed.

Once cloaked, the Baol will have to sacrifice their space-faring ambitions for the time being, as any ship sighted departing from the homeworld may reveal its location. Of course, this inconvenience is infinitely preferable to annihilation.

tooltips.zh: 星界隐形法令现已可用。
tooltips.en: Edict Astral Cloaking is now available.

label.zh: 行星隐形：解锁星界隐形法令

note.zh: 花费 50 星界丝缕选择此路；探索结束并解锁“星界隐形”法令。
note.en: Chosen for 50 astral threads; the exploration ends and the Astral Cloaking edict becomes available.

texts.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

如果巴奥和古茹努尔之间的冲突进一步升级，至少我们能够从战争的蹂躏中拯救他们的一些物种。
texts.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

If the conflict between the Baol and the Grunur escalates further, at least we were able to rescue some of their species from the ravages of war.

texts.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

当巴奥不可避免地被毁灭时，也许他们会因知道他们的物种将在另一个维度生存而感到慰藉。
texts.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

When the Baol are inevitably destroyed, perhaps they will take comfort in the knowledge that their species will live on in another dimension.

texts.zh:
离开巴奥殖民地时，我们被托付了一捆珍贵的幼苗。

我们希望他们的冲突能够尽快结束，巴奥能够在裂隙两边都繁荣昌盛。
texts.en:
Departing the Baol colony, we were entrusted with a bundle of their precious seedlings.

We hope that their conflict will end soon and that the Baol will live on prosperously on both sides of the rift.

note.zh: 探索结束；在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地生成一批巴奥人口（格式塔帝国生成蜂巢版巴奥）。
note.en: The exploration ends; a Baol pop group appears on the empire's colony nearest the rift (a hive-minded Baol species for gestalt empires).

texts.zh:
通过将星界丝缕整合到巴奥的防御技术中，我们在他们被围困的殖民地周围投射了一种反应式、但很坚固的行星护盾。护盾将包围行星并保护巴奥，只要它还存在。

希望它能存在足够长的时间，让古茹努尔继续前往更容易接近的目标。
texts.en:
By integrating astral thread into the Baol's defensive technology, we have projected a reactive yet sturdy form of planetary shielding around their besieged colony. The barrier will surround the planet and protect the Baol for as long as it stands.

Hopefully, it will survive long enough for the Grunur to move on to more accessible targets.

note.zh: 花费 100 星界丝缕选择此路；探索结束，获得“星界护盾实验”修正。
note.en: Chosen for 100 astral threads; the exploration ends with the Astral Shield Experimentation modifier.

texts.zh:
巴奥的问题，无论是军事上还是别的，我们都不关心。我们应该从另一个维度去观察和探索；我们也不想树立新的强大敌人。

蜂巢思维明显失望地接受了我们的决定，但让我们继续研究。
texts.en:
The Baol's problems, military or otherwise, are not our concern. We have journeyed from another dimension to observe and explore; we have no desire to make new and powerful enemies.

The hive mind accepted our decision with obvious disappointment, but left us to continue our research.

texts.zh:
我们准备了观测卫星并将它们发射到星球轨道上，这将使我们能够跨越裂隙传输一些数据。

现在，我们将研究巴奥先进的农业和生态系统管理技术。当那天真的来临的时候，我们还将捕捉到古茹努尔毁灭行星的关键镜头。
texts.en:
We prepared our observation satellites and launched them into terrestrial orbit, which should allow us to transmit some amount of data across the rift.

For now, we will study the Baol's advanced agriculture and ecosystem management techniques. When the time comes, we will also capture crucial footage of the planet's annihilation by the Grunur.

label.zh: 这是一个独特的研究机会。
label.en: This is a unique research opportunity.

texts.zh: 远离裂隙一端，位于[From.solar_system.GetName]的巴奥殖民地已被古茹努尔摧毁。我们从战斗中收集了详细的研究数据，但这个观测项目的目标已经被消除了。
texts.en: The Baol colony on the far side of the rift in [From.solar_system.GetName] has been destroyed by the Grunur. We gathered detailed research data from battle, but the target of this observation project has been eliminated.

note.zh: 3045/3046 结束探索并留下社会研究矿藏；约 720–1440 天后本篇发生，矿藏移除并给予研究产出。
note.en: 3045/3046 end the exploration and leave a society research deposit; this event follows about 720–1440 days later, removing the deposit and granting research.

texts.zh:
我们准备了观测卫星并将它们发射到星球轨道上，这将使我们能够跨越裂隙传输一些数据。

他们的冲突开始之前，我们可以研究巴奥尔星球及其生态系统管理。同时这场战争也应该为未来的研究提供有趣的数据点。
texts.en:
We prepared our observation satellites and launched them into terrestrial orbit, which should allow us to transmit some amount of data across the rift.

We will study the Baol planet and their ecosystem management until their conflict begins. This war should also provide interesting data points for future research.

label.zh: 这是一个独特的研究机会。
label.en: This is a unique research opportunity.

texts.zh:
在行星表面，我们遇到了一种巨大的生物，它的身体由复杂的根系网络组成。它用一种我们无法理解的语言表达着深刻而朴实的共鸣。然后它给了我们一棵幼苗，它轻轻地将自己固定在[Leader.GetName]的[Explorer.GetSpeciesHandName]上。它的抓握根由一种奇怪的材料制成。伸手去触碰[Explorer.GetNetworkName]，有一刻的瞬间意识；通过思想与根源的融合，建立了直接沟通的路径。

“你好，种子同胞。解释一下你是如何绕过封锁的，以及你来这里的目的。”
texts.en:
On the planet's surface, we encountered a massive creature whose body was formed by an intricate network of roots. It spoke with a deep, earthy resonance in a language we could not understand. It then offered us a seedling, which gently anchored itself to [Leader.GetName]'s [Explorer.GetSpeciesHandName]. Its grasping roots were formed of a strange material. Extending to touch [Explorer.GetNetworkName], there was a moment of instantaneous recognition; through the fusion of thought and root, a line of direct communication was established.

"Hail, seed kin. Explain how you bypassed the blockade, and for what purpose you have come."

"Halt, unidentified sapient. Explain how you bypassed the blockade. Are you here to parlay?"

texts.zh:
“我们正在为即将到来的战斗做好准备。遗憾的是，你们的探险可能比之前评估的要危险得多。”

植物类种族继续说到：“我们是巴奥，你们在我们的一个外围殖民地上登陆。我们被围困了，资源日益减少。外交毫无结果。侵略者公然嘲笑我们试图沟通的努力。他们自称古茹努尔。”

"我们相信他们的目标不是征服这个星球，而是毁灭它。他们似乎毫不留情。我们会礼貌地接受你们提供的任何援助。"
texts.en:
"We make preparations for a coming battle. Regrettably, your expedition may be much more dangerous than previously assessed."

The plantoid continued, "We are the Baol, and you have landed on one of our outer colonies. We are under siege, and our resources dwindle. Diplomacy is fruitless. The aggressors mock us openly, and laugh at our attempts to communicate. They identify themselves as the Grunur."

"We believe their aim is not to conquer this world, but to destroy it. It seems they know no mercy. We would graciously accept any assistance you can provide."

label.zh: 我们将尽我们所能提供帮助。
label.en: We will help however we can.
It is not our place to interfere.

texts.zh:
由于外交是不可能的选项，我们需要更有创造性的方案以提供支持。

我们已经与巴奥进行讨论确定提供援助的实用方法。
texts.en:
With diplomacy out of the question, we will need to be creative in our support.

We've engaged in discussions with the Baol to determine a practical way to lend aid.

texts.zh: 巴奥可以尝试自卫，但他们军事能力有限。他们可以从机械或基因增强中受益，以提高陆军的速度、力量和对燃烧武器的抵抗力。
texts.en: The Baol can attempt to defend themselves, but have limited military capabilities. They would benefit from mechanical or genetic enhancement to improve their armies' speed, strength and resistance to incendiary weapons.

texts.zh: 我们可以用临时隐形装置遮蔽他们的母星，从而帮助巴奥躲避古茹努尔。这个殖民地仍然会消失，但至少他们的文明所在地将会幸存。
texts.en: We may help the Baol evade the Grunur by obscuring their homeworld with a temporary cloaking device. This colony would still be lost, but at least the seat of their civilization will survive.

texts.zh: 我们可以尝试用星界丝缕来增强巴奥的先进有机技术。应该可以在这个殖民地周围建立一个强大的护盾。当然，这将使他们无法离开这颗行星，但至少他们也可以免受入侵者的侵害。
texts.en: We could attempt to enhance the Baol's advanced organic technology with astral thread. It should be possible to establish a powerful shield around this colony. Of course, this will prevent them from leaving the planet, but at least they would be safe from the invaders.

texts.zh: 作为最后的手段，我们可以将巴奥幼苗带回裂隙，无论这个维度发生什么，这个物种都将能够继续生存。
texts.en: As a last resort, we could carry Baol seedlings back through the Rift, allowing the species to live on no matter what happens in this dimension.

label.zh: 部署实验性行星隐形技术。

texts.zh:
我们进入盖亚行星轨道，立即遇到了巡逻的战舰。我们试图沟通，回应我们的却是沉默。

一支巡逻队护送我们前往他们的旗舰，这是一艘装备齐全的主宰，周围有数十艘支援船。当我们的裂隙探球降落在一个大机库时，我们立即被一队士兵拘留。它们的甲壳和锯齿状的钳子让人想起几种已知的甲壳类动物。他们迈着完美的步调向前行进，呈现出一种令人畏惧的形象，但从他们的铠甲头上伸出的圆圆的眼睛却显得机警而聪明。

我们认为这个物种就是古茹努尔，一个数十万年前生活在我们宇宙中的高度侵略性的种族。众所周知，这个物种对被称为巴奥的植物类蜂巢思维物种进行了灭绝。我们假设这个裂隙将我们置于一个平行宇宙中，古茹努尔在其中仍然保持着军事活跃。
texts.en:
We entered orbit around the Gaia planet and were immediately confronted by patrolling warships. Our attempts at communication were met with silence.

A patrol escorted us to their flagship, a heavily outfitted Juggernaut surrounded by dozens of support vessels. Landing our Rift Sphere in a large hangar, we were immediately taken into custody by a squad of soldiers. Their armored carapaces and jagged pincers recalled several known species of crustacean. Marching forward in perfect lock-step, they presented an intimidating image, but the beady eyes protruding from their armored heads were alert and intelligent.

We recognized the species as the Grunur, a highly aggressive race that lived in our universe hundreds thousands of years ago. Famously, this species was responsible for the genocide of the plantoid hive mind known as the Baol. We hypothesize that this rift has deposited us in a parallel universe in which the Grunur remain militarily active.

label.en: Let us see where this leads...

texts.zh:
我们被引导到一个中央房间。一个复杂的控制面板容纳了几种巨大的甲壳类动物，它们的钳子以惊人的精度插入到一个专门的接口中。每个终端都包含大量的水晶，显然是通过工作人员胸腔深处产生的声音操纵的。房间中央站着一位身穿破烂军装的舰队司令。它发出一声命令，它的属下立即开始行动。

我们的一个无人机被立即拘束并扫描。一个锋利的仪器直接刺入了它的中央处理单元，使其失去了活力。处理单元很快被传递给甲壳类领袖，后者将其插入命令控制台上的一个水晶中。

水晶中响起了清脆的声音，用我们的母语说到：谈时已到。汝皆何人？
texts.en:
We were shepherded into a central chamber. A complex control panel housed several massive crustaceans, their pincers slotted with remarkable precision into a specialized interface. Each terminal contained a font of crystals, apparently manipulated by the sounds produced from deep within the crew members' chests. In the center of the room stood an admiral in tattered regalia. It barked a command, and its subordinates broke into action.

One of our research drones was summarily restrained and scanned. A sharp instrument was plunged directly into its CPU, rendering it inert. The processing unit was quickly passed to the crustacean leader, who inserted it into one of the crystals on their command console.

A ringing voice resonated out from the crystals in our native language: "IT IS TIME FOR TALKING. WHO ARE YOU?"

texts.zh:
我们介绍自己是来自平行宇宙的科学家。

在我们的世界里，古茹努尔早已消失。根据考古记录，他们是一个征服者的种族，拥有大量先进的武器……并且有残忍倾向。他们消灭巴奥的行动无论是效率还是场面都堪称传奇。他们注定要毁灭这个星系中的巴奥殖民地。

当我们的话语被翻译时，古茹努尔士兵发出一连串的喘息声。我们认为这是他们的笑声。然而，舰队领袖的固执沉默很快又恢复了礼仪。通过翻译水晶，它说道：

“知晓，然后？如若知晓，便会给予。”
texts.en:
We introduce ourselves as scientists from a parallel universe.

In our world, the Grunur have long since disappeared. Based on the archaeological record, they were a race of conquerors, possessing a vast arsenal of advanced weaponry... as well as a tendency for cruelty. Their extermination of the Baol is legendary both for its efficacy as well as its spectacle. They are destined to destroy the Baol colony in this system.

As our words were translated, the Grunur soldiers emitted a series of popping gasps. We took this to be their version of laughter. However, the obstinate silence of the ship's leader soon restored decorum. Through the translation crystal, it spoke:

"KNOWING, THEN? IF KNOWING IS, THEN GIVING WILL BE."

texts.zh:
我们向古茹努尔舰队司令分享了有关人造龙鳞装甲的研究数据。几乎立刻，对抗的气氛就减弱了。古茹努尔显然对我们对先进战争的承诺印象深刻。

他们计划在即将到来的灭绝行动中使用该技术。为了表达谢意，舰队司令赠送了我们一块数据水晶。从所提供的解释中，我们了解到它包含宝贵的军事机密，包括我们之前所未知的策略和技术。它还包括对古茹努尔军事历史的详尽描述——一份长达数百卷的记录——或许对我们来说也没什么用。
texts.en:
We shared our research data on Artificial Dragonscales with the Grunur admiral. Almost immediately, the air of confrontation waned. The Grunur were obviously impressed with our commitment to advanced warfare.

They plan to use the technology in their upcoming extermination campaign. As a show of gratitude, the admiral gifted us a data crystal. From the explanation provided, we understand it contains valuable military secrets, including previously unknown stratagems and techniques. Perhaps less helpfully, it also includes a meticulously detailed account of the Grunur's military history - a record that spans hundreds of volumes.

This new interface will give us a decided edge in combat and allow us to more thoroughly dominate our enemies.

然而，我们发现了他们的宇航技术的一个独特的先进方面，这可能会彻底改变我们当前的武器系统。虽然是为古茹努尔的生理特性设计的，但我们可以适应界面，这可以提高瞄准精度。

texts.zh:
古茹努尔非常感谢我们能够分享有关巴奥的信息。鉴于他们的种族对间谍活动和其他间接战争方法缺乏兴趣，我们的信息无疑将帮助他们在即将到来的灭绝期间完善他们的策略。

尽管如此，他们的海军上将仍然保持警惕：

"知晓诚可贵，见证才更佳。目睹灭绝事，方知学无涯。"
texts.en:
The Grunur appreciated what we were able to share about the Baol. Given their species' lack of interest in espionage and other methods of indirect warfare, our information will undoubtedly help them to refine their strategy during the upcoming extermination.

Despite this, their admiral remained guarded:

"KNOWING IS, BUT SEEING IS BETTER. WITNESS EXTERMINATION, THEN MORE LEARNING."

texts.zh:
我们看着古茹努尔开始轰炸巴奥殖民地。他们舰队的压倒性优势迅速摧毁了巴奥脆弱的防御。

当古茹努尔陆军袭击行星表面时，一切都陷入了熊熊大火。配备火焰喷射器的部队以可怕的效率焚烧了当地的植物。

不可避免的胜利缓解了古茹努尔海军上将的嘶哑声。

“我见。我烧。知晓，现在？"

袭击中使用的火焰武器样本已被拿出来供我们检查。

“涤火皆净。汝可拿去。汝敌皆惧。"
texts.en:
We watched as the Grunur began their bombardment of the Baol colony. The overwhelming superiority of their fleet swiftly demolished the Baol's feeble defenses.

As the Grunur brigades stormed the planet's surface, all was set to flame. Troops armed with flamethrowers incinerated the native plantoids with terrible efficiency.

The inevitable victory softened the Grunur admiral's croaks.

"SEEING IS. BURNING IS. KNOWING, NOW?"

A sample of the flame weaponry used in the attack was brought forth for our inspection.

"BURNING IS CLEAN. TAKE. MAKE FEAR."

Our scientists beyond the rift in [solar_system.GetName] are being held captive by the Grunur.

The anchor cable has been retracted, and the Rift Sphere retrieved. Download of the final data logs is already in progress.

We can only hope that the Grunur will show mercy to the Sphere's crew. And who can say? The rifts between the worlds are little understood... Perhaps, given luck, they may even find a way back.

texts.en: [Leader.GetName] [Leader.GetHasHave] unexpectedly returned from [Leader.GetHisHer] detention within the Grunur fleet on the other side of the Astral Rift in [From.solar_system.GetName]. Caught somewhere between this time and another, [Leader.GetHisHer] age seems indeterminable. Kept as a slave by the Grunur, [Leader.GetHeShe] [Leader.GetHasHave] become well-versed in designing new weapons for interstellar combat.

note.en: In 3095 the scientist is detained by the Grunur and the exploration ends; about 1800–2520 days later the scientist returns with new traits, including Rift Warped.

texts.zh:
我们解释说，我们是来自另一个维度的研究人员，我们的使命是探索改变宇宙以及宇宙中存在的各种现象。

当我们陈述我们的意图时，海军上将轻蔑地哼了一声。我们周围的士兵变得焦躁不安、喧闹起来，发出大声的叫喊声和呱呱声。
看到，然后？见证已毕。乞愿将始。
texts.en:
We explained that we were researchers from another dimension on a mission to explore alternate universes and the various phenomena that exist within them.

The admiral grunted dismissively as we stated our intentions. The soldiers around us grew restless and raucous, ululating and croaking loudly.

"LOOKING, THEN? SEEING IS DONE. BEGGING BEGINS."

label.zh: 虚张声势地回应。不要被吓倒。
label.en: Respond with bravado. Do not be intimidated.

texts.zh:
这是一个冒险的举动，但我们的勇敢得到了回报。古茹努尔的指挥官对我们通过裂隙探球在宇宙之间穿梭的故事印象特别深刻。看来，展现勇敢和英勇是古茹努尔人的典型特征。对他们来说，对话总是有赢家和输家——而这次对话显然为我们赢得了一些分数。我们甚至亲眼目睹了一些钳子发出的咔哒声表示赞同。

最终，领导者带着一连串有节奏的嘎嘎声从终端站起来。

“勇敢固好，行动最佳。时机已至，赢取尊重。”

一根水晶竖井矗立在我们面前，和指挥控制台周围竖立的竖井类似。

"发射开始。等待命令。"
texts.en:
It was a risky gambit, but our bravado paid off. The Grunur general was particularly impressed by our tales of slipping between universes via the Rift Sphere. It seems that such displays of bravery and prowess are typical things for the Grunur. To them, a conversation always has a winner and a loser - and this dialogue had apparently scored us some points. We even witnessed some pincers clacking in approval.

Eventually, the leader rose from their terminal with a series of measured croaks.

"BRAVERY IS, BUT DOING IS BEST. RESPECT TO BE GAINED."

A crystalline shaft rose before us, similar to the ones erected around the command console.

"LAUNCHING BEGINS. ORDER AWAITS."

label.en: Press the crystal. Order the launch.

texts.zh:
古茹努尔根本就没有兴趣听我们解释。

舰队司令从终端那站起来，并发出一连串的嘎嘎声，其中夹杂着钳子发出的尖锐的折断声。

"审判结束。惩戒开始。"

我们被带到一间牢房。从我们警卫的“笑声”来看，我们的命运不太可能是美好的。我们的设备正被拿走。这将是我们最后的传输。

愿我们的家人幸福安康。
texts.en:
The Grunur were simply not interested in listening to reason.

The admiral rose from the terminal with a series of croaks, punctuated with sharp snaps from their pincers.

"JUDGMENT IS. PUNISHMENT AWAITS."

We were led to a holding cell. Based on the 'laughter' of our guards, our fate is unlikely to be a pretty one. Our equipment is being taken. This will be our last transmission.

Send our best to our families.

# 天堂围攻 / Siege on Paradise

- 分类 Category：星界裂隙 Astral rifts (C4) · DLC：星界位面 Astral Planes
- 来源 Sources：`common/astral_rifts/00_astral_rifts.txt:392`（裂隙定义 rift definition）；`events/astral_rifts_3_events.txt:11–1583`（3000–3099）；`common/inline_scripts/astral_rift/3060_tech_option.txt`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（全篇 whole story）

## 如何开始 How it starts

科学家乘科研船进入一处星界裂隙后，裂隙类型从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取。本裂隙基础权重 1；帝国正在进行巴奥事件链时 ×2，已完成时 ×4（`00_astral_rifts.txt:392–410`）。探索分阶段进行：每阶段结束掷一次 1–10 的骰子，加上科学家技能加值与线索、减去本章难度，结果 ≥14 即取得突破，进入下一章；第一章 3000 难度为 0。

A scientist on a science ship enters an astral rift; the rift type is drawn from the explorer's rift pool by weight. This rift has base weight 1, ×2 while the empire runs the Baol event chain and ×4 once it has completed it (`00_astral_rifts.txt:392–410`). Exploration runs in phases: at the end of each phase a d10 is rolled, skill bonus and clues are added and the chapter difficulty subtracted; a result of 14 or more is a breakthrough that opens the next chapter. The first chapter, 3000, has difficulty 0.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

裂隙另一侧是一颗被精心照料的花园行星：植物类居民正在加固城市，星系外一支重装舰队已完成封锁（3000）。玩家先选择联络谁：

- **联络行星居民**（3000.a）：若帝国已接触巴奥事件链，科学家认出他们正是本宇宙早已灭绝的巴奥人（3005），并告知其未来，3010 中巴奥人请求援助；否则以“我们是探险家”的身份结识（3006），在 3015 中听巴奥人自述被古茹努尔围困。两条路线随后汇合：援助（3020/3021 的四种方案）或袖手旁观（3025）。
- **联络在轨舰队**（3000.b）：科学家被古茹努尔旗舰扣押审问（3050 → 3055）。知晓巴奥历史的帝国可以说出“我们看到了你们的未来”（3060），否则只能表明探险家身份（3065）。

At the far side lies a meticulously tended garden world: plantoid inhabitants fortify their cities while a heavily armed fleet blockades the system (3000). The player chooses whom to contact:

- **The inhabitants** (3000.a): if the empire knows the Baol event chain, the scientists recognise them as the Baol, extinct in our universe (3005), reveal their fate and receive a plea for help (3010); otherwise they introduce themselves as explorers (3006) and hear the Baol describe the Grunur siege (3015). Both routes reach the same decision: help with one of four plans (3020/3021) or stay out of it (3025).
- **The orbiting fleet** (3000.b): the scientists are taken aboard the Grunur flagship and questioned (3050 → 3055). An empire that knows the Baol history can say it has “seen your future” (3060); otherwise it can only claim to be explorers (3065).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

援助巴奥（3020/3021，内容相同，只是前文不同）：

- 基因改造（需基因剪裁科技）→ 3030 基因强化，结束探索，并可招募巴奥指挥官“橡树茎”（3031，可先问四个问题再招募或遣散）。
- 行星隐形（需基础隐形场，花费 50 星界丝缕）→ 3035，结束探索，解锁“星界隐形”法令。
- 保存幼苗（总可选）→ 3040，结束探索，在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地出现一批巴奥人口。
- 星界护盾（仅在未同时拥有上述两项科技时出现，花费 100 星界丝缕）→ 3049，获得“星界护盾实验”修正。

袖手旁观（3025）→ 3045 或 3046（按是否知晓巴奥人），结束探索并留下社会研究矿藏；约 720–1440 天后 3047“土归土”：殖民地被古茹努尔毁灭，矿藏移除，换取研究产出。

古茹努尔路线：

- 3060 中分享一项本帝国已有的军事科技 → 3070 → 3085，获得“古茹努尔武器界面”修正。
- 分享巴奥研究数据 → 3075；观看灭绝 → 3090，可建造“焰爆部队”；拒绝 → 3095。
- 拒绝合作 → 3095（本章难度 +1）。
- 未知巴奥人时（3065）：虚张声势 → 3076，按下水晶下令发射 → 3090，拒绝 → 3095；讲道理 → 3080 被判惩罚 → 3095。
- 3095“远征结束”：科学家被古茹努尔扣押，探索结束；约 1800–2520 天后科学家归来（3099），获得推进或舰船相关专长与“裂隙扭曲”特质。

Helping the Baol (3020/3021 offer the same four plans after different lead-ins):

- Genetic modification (requires Gene Tailoring) → 3030, the exploration ends and the Baol commander Oakenstalk can be enlisted (3031, a recruitment window with four questions, then Enlist or Dismiss).
- Planetary cloaking (requires Basic Cloaking Fields, costs 50 astral threads) → 3035, unlocks the Astral Cloaking edict.
- Preserve the seedlings (always available) → 3040, a Baol pop group appears on the empire's colony nearest the rift.
- Astral shield (shown only if the empire lacks one of the two technologies; costs 100 astral threads) → 3049, Astral Shield Experimentation modifier.

Staying out (3025) → 3045 or 3046 (by Baol knowledge), which ends the exploration and leaves a society research deposit; about 720–1440 days later 3047 “Dust to Dust” reports the colony destroyed, removes the deposit and grants research.

The Grunur route:

- Share one military technology the empire owns (3060) → 3070 → 3085, Grunur Weapons Interface modifier.
- Share Baol research data → 3075; watch the extermination → 3090 (Flamestorm Troopers can be built); refuse → 3095.
- Refuse to cooperate → 3095 (chapter difficulty +1).
- Without Baol knowledge (3065): bravado → 3076, then press the crystal (→ 3090) or refuse (→ 3095); reasoning → 3080 punishment → 3095.
- 3095 “Expedition's End”: the scientist is detained by the Grunur and the exploration ends; about 1800–2520 days later the scientist returns (3099) with a propulsion or voidcraft expertise and the Rift Warped trait.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 巴奥事件链状态决定 3000.a、3025.a、3050、3055 出现哪一个版本，以及 3005/3010/3020/3040/3090 的叙述。
- 3055 的开场描写随科学家物种而变（机械、有机、岩石）；3085 的感想随和平/军国/灭绝倾向而变；3095 对格式塔帝国使用另一段文字。这些差异由探索时设置的裂隙描述标记决定（`astral_planes.6`），网站目前把它们显示为未解析的条件。
- 3060 只出现一个“分享科技”选项：3055.a 按固定顺序记录帝国拥有的第一项相关科技（`astral_rifts_3_events.txt:975–998`）。

- The Baol event chain status selects which version of 3000.a, 3025.a, 3050 and 3055 appears and changes the narration of 3005/3010/3020/3040/3090.
- 3055's opening varies with the scientist's species (machine, organic, lithoid); 3085 varies for pacifist/militarist/exterminator empires; 3095 has a gestalt text. These variants are chosen by rift description flags set when each chapter fires (`astral_planes.6`); the site currently shows them as unresolved conditions.
- Only one “Share <technology>” option appears in 3060: 3055.a records the first relevant technology the empire owns, in a fixed order (`astral_rifts_3_events.txt:975–998`).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：裂隙定义与权重；3000–3099 全部事件的选项条件、费用、`set_next_astral_rift_event` 目标、`finish_astral_rift`、延时后续 3047（720+720 天）与 3098→3099（1800+720 天）；3060 内联选项脚本。本裂隙没有 `on_roll_failed` 失败分支。
- 修正：编译草稿结构正确；新增三组互斥说明（按巴奥事件链二选一）、八个结局标注和 3060 选项说明。
- 不确定：描述标记驱动的文本变体尚未被条件模型解析（见台账 Requests）。

- Checked: rift definition and weight; every event 3000–3099 — option conditions and costs, `set_next_astral_rift_event` targets, `finish_astral_rift`, the delayed follow-ups 3047 (720+720 days) and 3098→3099 (1800+720 days), and the 3060 inline option script. This rift has no `on_roll_failed` failure branch.
- Corrections: the compiled draft was structurally correct; added three exclusive groups (Baol-chain variants), eight ending labels and a note on the 3060 options.
- Uncertain: description-flag text variants are not resolved by the condition model (see ledger Requests).
